hunks.sol: “My grandfather said climbing up was hard, but going down was easy. He said if I endured it for just a moment, I’d be back down in no time.”

hunks.baseline: The edge of the cliff ledge where Hyuk Mujin and I were lying—barely ten square meters in size—began to shake.
hunks.sol: The edge of the cliff where Hyuk Mujin and I lay—an area barely ten square meters wide—began to shake.

hunks.baseline: As we lay there in a daze, Cheongpung waved at us.
hunks.sol: As we stared blankly, Cheongpung waved.
